categories.main_business_segments: Finework (Hunan) New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the high-strength fasteners sector, focusing on wind power full-series fasteners. It also develops and manufactures aerospace components, gas turbine parts, oil equipment fasteners, and nuclear power components. The company serves multiple industries including wind power, aerospace, gas turbines, and oil equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as heat treatment, metal plastic forming, mechanical processing, surface coating, and intelligent manufacturing. It integrates lean production with smart manufacturing, utilizing IoT, MES, ERP systems, automated production lines, and industrial robots to enhance quality, efficiency, and cost control. It has developed proprietary information management platforms and holds numerous patents and industry standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Finework serves major domestic and international wind turbine manufacturers, EPC contractors, and wind farm operators, including well-known enterprises like GE, TPI, Nordex, and Chinese leading wind power companies. It also supplies aerospace engine manufacturers, gas turbine producers, and oil equipment companies. The company targets both domestic and overseas markets, with a strategic focus on expanding its global footprint.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hunan Province and multiple subsidiaries across China. It has expanded overseas with wholly-owned subsidiaries and factories in Vietnam, Singapore, and Hong Kong, aiming to increase its presence in Southeast Asia and other international markets including Europe, North America, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Finework operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of high-strength fasteners and precision components. It controls raw material procurement, production, and direct sales to end customers, providing integrated fastening system solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-strength fasteners, smart manufacturing, and digital factory capabilities under Industry 4.0. It invests in R&D for advanced coatings, automated production lines, and efficiency improvements. Strategic initiatives include expanding overseas production, developing aerospace and other high-end equipment fasteners, and extending its product portfolio to wind tower manufacturing and wind farm operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products, including fasteners and precision components, to customers via contracts, tenders, and business negotiations. The company also derives income from government subsidies and investment returns but mainly relies on product sales in domestic and international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Finework is a leading national high-tech enterprise in the wind power fastener industry with a strong market position domestically and growing international influence. It competes with other specialized fastener manufacturers and suppliers in the wind power and aerospace sectors, leveraging its technological capabilities, quality control, and customer relationships to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Finework reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.79 billion, a 9.21% increase year-over-year, but experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 157 million due to pricing pressures and investment in new business lines. The company has total assets of about RMB 3.6 billion, showing a 19% growth from the previous year, with ongoing investments in production capacity and overseas expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Finework emphasizes high product quality, advanced manufacturing technology, and comprehensive quality control systems certified by ISO9001, IATF16949, and AS9100D. Its smart manufacturing capabilities and patented technologies enable consistent product performance and rapid delivery. The company offers integrated fastening system solutions tailored to customer needs, supporting large-scale wind power projects and high-end aerospace applications, thereby differentiating itself through innovation, reliability, and global service.
